scheme.name: PURNA Scheme
scheme.summary: The "PURNA Scheme" launched by the Women and Child Development Department, Gujarat, is a comprehensive initiative designed for adolescent girls aged 15-18 in Gujarat. It focuses on improving their nutritional status, health, and life skills while empowering them through education, vocational training, and exposure to public services.
eligibility: The applicant must be a girl.
The applicant must be aged between 15-18 years.
Applicant must be enrolled at an Anganwadi center in Gujarat.
scheme.benefits: Nutritional support with PURNA Shakti packets, health enhancement with IFA tablets and health check-ups, educational encouragement, life skill development, public exposure visits, awareness programs like PURNA divas, and empowerment kits.
scheme.how_to_apply: Visit the nearest Anganwadi centres, submit age proof and enrollment details, and register for the scheme with the assistance of the Anganwadi worker.
